title: Detect ROIs (Quicky)
description: dev's Quicky (flufinder) detection, natively in both languages: frames are binned by their maximum, the smooth and slow background taken out, each bin thresholded at a percentile and cleaned with disk-shaped morphology, and the places where the thresholded areas come back in at least observationsRequired bins become ROIs. Saved as ophys.detect_rois saves them. Areas are compared deterministically (by centroids within 3 px of their median), where flufinder clusters them, and its shape detection is not part of it; ophys.flufinder runs flufinder itself.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: ROIs
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

observationsRequired.title: Bins a cell must be seen in
